name: Kentucky Christian University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2026-27 tuition & fees ($27,530 block tuition for 12-18 credit hours + $600 General Student Services Fee = $28,130) from official Annual Cost of Attendance (Undergraduate) PDF at kcu.edu/annual-cost-of-attendance-all-programs (2026-27-Annual-Cost-of-Attendance-All-Programs.pdf). Housing $11,140 is a combined 'Housing & Food (Dorm & Continuous Service Meal Plan)' figure; no room-only amount is published, so this is room + board.
